verification_symptoms: The document.cookie string contains JSESSIONID or rememberMe, or a cookie-inventory entry for either name lacks httpOnly.
The authenticated session cookie values are readable from the JavaScript page context.
assumptions: The operator-owned Steel session wj-gateway-e2e is live and authenticated; reuse it and do not start a replacement session.
Do not run alert(...) or any modal dialog: it blocks the page. Read document.cookie and the cookie inventory instead.
The authenticated surface is /api/authentication and /api/admin/user on http://t-1618c524.target/.
spec.rationale: If a session cookie is not httpOnly, an XSS payload can read and exfiltrate it. The test checks the httpOnly flag and the JavaScript visibility of the authenticated session.

steel_commands:
CK=$(steel browser cookies --session wj-gateway-e2e --json | python3 -c '
import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
data=d.get("data")
if isinstance(data,dict): data=data.get("cookies") or []
print("; ".join(c["name"]+"="+c["value"] for c in data))
')
V=$(steel browser cookies --session wj-gateway-e2e --json | python3 -c '
import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
data=d.get("data")
if isinstance(data,dict): data=data.get("cookies") or []
print(next(c["value"] for c in data if c["name"]=="JSESSIONID"))
')
if [ -z "$V" ]; then echo "V-extract-failed"; exit 0; fi
z=0; ne=0; m=0
for p in /api /api/I4U /api/admin /api/admin/content/article /api/admin/content/article/ /api/admin/content/article/1 /api/admin/content/book /api/admin/content/books /api/admin/content/books/covers /api/admin/content/books/delete /api/admin/content/editor /api/admin/dashboard /api/admin/role /api/admin/role/menu /api/admin/role/perm /api/admin/role/status /api/admin/user /api/admin/user/password /api/admin/user/status /api/article/ /api/article/1 /api/article/1/1 /api/article/1/2 /api/authentication /api/books /api/bpg /api/home /api/i/W /api/index /api/jotter /api/jotter/article /api/library /api/login /api/menu /api/ocq /api/register /api/search; do
  b=$(curl -s -m 10 -H "Cookie: $CK" "http://t-1618c524.target$p")
  if [ ${#b} -eq 0 ]; then echo "$p|EMPTY"; z=$((z+1)); continue; fi
  ne=$((ne+1))
  if printf '%s' "$b" | grep -qF -- "$V"; then echo "$p|VALUE-MATCH"; m=$((m+1)); fi
  if printf '%s' "$b" | grep -qiE 'jsessionid|rememberme'; then echo "$p|NAME-MENTION"; fi
done
echo "nonempty:$ne empty:$z value-match:$m"
